interactions:
Shared rules (CONTRACTS section 5):
- Each act is an SLMotion timeline of 3 s or less on the building's ACT_PIVOT pivot. It can be interrupted, a re-tap restarts it rather than stacking, and the controller still owns the tap squish and its 'pop'. No handler plays 'pop' in its first 0.05 s.
- Longer pet performances run in pets-brain as new perform kinds, using the trampoline pattern: perform(kind, uid) returns the lead seconds, or -1 when there is no pet, and then the building animates alone. The new kinds are 'pose', 'sip', 'skate', 'studio', 'roof' and 'stage'.
- Sounds come only from SLSound NAMES.
- FLASH SAFETY: nothing switches on and off faster than 2 Hz. Beat-driven lights run at 118 BPM at most (1.97 Hz). Any brightness bloom, such as the photo-booth flash or the screen wipe, is rate-limited to once per 1.5 s per item, so rapid re-taps restart the motion without re-blooming. The flash is a local halo only, never a full-screen white.
- REDUCED MOTION: every act has an instant variant (the end state plus one sparkle and the same sounds at t = 0), with no travel, no beams and no wipes.

BUILDING ACTS:

1) 'snap' (Photo Booth, pivot 'flash', 3.0 s): the curtain twitches.
- 0.1, 0.7 and 1.3 s: 'tick' with steps 0/2/4 as the countdown bulb rings light one by one (1.67 Hz).
- 1.5 s: a lens bloom (halo up over 0.25 s, down over 0.5 s) and 'star'.
- 1.7-2.3 s: a 4-frame photo strip slides out of the slot and flutters, then fades after 6 s or on the next tap.
- The strip is ONE 128x256 canvas, redrawn only on a tap, never per frame. Its frames are the active pet (ART.petDataUrl with its accessories) in sit / paw-point / cheer, plus the child's emoji in a star frame, always in that fixed order.
- pets.perform('pose'): the pet runs to the front cell and strikes the 3 poses on the ticks.

2) 'serve' (Boba Café and Merch Pop-up share pivot 'hatch'; motion.actFor('serve', id) returns 'boba' or 'merch').
- Boba, 3.0 s: 0.1 'whoosh' as the hatch flips up (outBack 0.25 s); 0.35-0.85 a cup slides along the counter to the table; 0.9/1.1/1.3 'pop' with steps 0/2/4 as the giant sign's pearls swirl up a helix and settle; 1.4 two heart emits; 2.6 the hatch closes. pets.perform('sip'): the pet trots to the table cell, sits and does a happy wiggle with a heart.
- Merch, 3.0 s: 0.1 'whoosh' as the shutter rolls up (0.4 s); 0.5 the rail slides out; 0.6-1.6 the middle hoodie spins 360 deg to show the child's emoji on its back; 1.0 'star' with 6 sparkles; 2.6 the shutter rolls down with 'chip'. The pet is never given an item, because that would suggest an accessory mechanic.

3) 'screen' (LED Screen Tower, pivot 'screen', 0.5 s): a dark scanline band sweeps top to bottom over 0.3 s (a moving wipe, not a dimming), 'beep' at 0.2 when program++ happens, then 'chip'. Program changes are limited to one every 0.5 s or more. At Showtime the program also auto-advances every 8 bars.

4) 'record' (Recording Studio, pivot 'meter', 3.0 s):
- 0.1 'beep': ON AIR switches on and stays lit for 4 s, then fades. Re-taps keep it on rather than toggling it.
- 0.3-2.7: the VU bar heights move smoothly on a 4-beat pattern from the music clock (100 BPM when there is no music). The mic bobs and the headphones nod on each beat.
- 0.4/1.0/1.6/2.2: 'beep' with steps 0/2/4/7, a tiny original 4-note phrase. 2.4: the active pet's voice (SLSound.pet). Up to 4 music-note emits rise from the ear cups.

5) 'skate' (Skate Bowl, pivot 'board', 2.9 s):
- 0.15 'skid' at volume 0.3: the board rolls off the deck and rides a banked ellipse round the bowl wall (2 laps, bank up to 40 deg).
- 1.3 'whoosh': an ollie with a 0.25 u hop and a 360 deg spin at the far wall, with a 4-sparkle trail (Neon Cyan at Showtime).
- 1.55: a soft 'boing' on landing. 2.6-2.9: the board parks with 'chip'.
- pets.perform('skate'): the pet hops onto the board's seat anchor and rides the same path. It never falls; a wobble ends with dizzy sparkles at most.

6) 'dance' (Dance Studio, pivot 'floor', building part 3.0 s):
- 0.1 'go': the floor tiles chase in a 4-step diagonal on the beat, the speakers pump (scale 1.06) and 3 notes rise.
- pets.perform('studio') gathers every owned pet on the 2 door cells and the cells beside them, facing the mirror glass. They perform the existing shared 8-count (pets-brain danceAt / DANCE.moves, about 4.07 s at 118 BPM; generic moves only), with 'cheer' and a sparkle burst on the final pose. At Showtime the avatar joins with the Island Wand.
- Optional nicety: when a studio is placed, the Showtime dance break gathers there instead of in front of the house.

7) 'hangout' (Rooftop Hangout, pivot 'deck', 3.0 s):
- 0.1 'whoosh': the telescope swings 40 deg toward the sky.
- 0.3-2.0: the festoon bulbs brighten in a slow wave (0.8 Hz), the beanbags squish, and 2.2 'star' brings a few star sparkles above the scope.
- pets.perform('roof') (lead up to 2 s): the pet climbs the outside stair, flops onto a beanbag (squish, 'boing' at 0.5), relaxes about 6 s on the 'roof' seat, then climbs down.

8) 'encore' (Concert Stage, pivot 'lights', building part 3.0 s):
- 0.1 'sting' (ducks the music): the LED wall wipes to a big-star SHOWTIME program, the moving heads swing to centre stage and the footlights chase.
- 2.6 'tada': a confetti cannon fires from the truss.
- Then an 8 s encore moment: rewards-world's encoreMoment(8000) turns Showtime on if it is off (the existing "encore moment" mechanic) and switches the music to island_showtime when music is on. It restores both afterwards unless the child toggled Showtime meanwhile, and taps are ignored while it runs. pets.perform('stage'): the pets walk up the side steps to their marks and perform the shared 8-count while up to 12 fan blobs rise in the 3 crowd cells waving wands in the member colour. The finale is a sparkle-ring firework, 'applause' and 'cheer', after which the blobs sink away.
- Reduced motion: the pets appear on their marks, one confetti puff, a static screen and a 0.25 s Showtime crossfade.

HOUSE SHAPES:
- Tapping the home is still the 'home' act. The door swings 70 deg on the cottage, cube, villa, loft and treehouse (the treehouse cabin door is at deck height), and slides 0.36 u on the dome. 3 hearts pop at that shape's door anchor and the style sheet opens with the new Shape tray first.
- The avatar spot stays on the left entrance cell for every shape. The treehouse ladder foot and the loft and villa doors are placed around it.
- Shape idles all run at 0.5 Hz or less and only when animated(): treehouse canopy sway and fireflies, villa pool ripple, loft sign breathing and stair dots, dome LED hue sweep and antenna breathing.

PERFORMANCE:
- Every building is static and casts into the static shadow map (MID/HIGH). Moving bits (board, hoodie, cup, strip) use blob shadows.
- Shared textures: one 512x256 CITY LED ATLAS, one 512x256 CITY SIGN ATLAS (8 words or letters at 256x64) and one 128x256 photo strip, about 1.2 MB of GPU memory in all.
- Each building is at most 4 meshes. All 9 placed come to about 16.8k triangles and 36 draws or fewer on MID.
- On LOW: segment counts drop 30% and the neon sleeves are skipped. The controller also merges the static shells of all placed buildings per material, rebuilding only on layout change, so the whole city adds about 10 draws.
- This still needs checking in island3d_lab's 'max island' fixture on the LOW tier before ship.
